description: The universal-search panel. Tauri's ACL is per-window, so this window needs its own capability or it launches with nothing: no event listener for its show signal, no way to hide itself on Esc, no draggable title bar. core:window:default covers read-only queries only, hence the two explicit grants. Showing and focusing happen in Rust, so allow-show / allow-set-focus are deliberately not here.
